name: coquibot/coqui
description: Personal operating system — lightweight agent runtime with multi-model orchestration and persistent sessions

suggest.ext-gd: Recommended for bundled image previews in coqui-toolkit-images and for release or Docker build parity
suggest.ext-xdebug: Recommended for optional profiling, Xdebug-backed coverage runs, and step debugging during performance investigations
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required for background task cancellation via SIGTERM
suggest.ext-posix: Required for background task process management

scripts.test-bash: bash tests/bash/launcher-sigint-test.sh && bash tests/bash/launcher-default-mode-test.sh && bash tests/bash/mock-install-test.sh
scripts.lint-bash: shellcheck bin/coqui-launcher tests/bash/launcher-sigint-test.sh tests/bash/launcher-default-mode-test.sh tests/bash/mock-install-test.sh scripts/build.sh scripts/ci-test.sh scripts/mock-install.sh scripts/sync-workspace-toolkits.sh
